recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. Do not make a redundant source edit for FHIR-40029; handle any future semantic prefix-boundary changes under their own Jira issues, as was done for FHIR-40319.
issue_request: FHIR-40029 was Published/Persuasive for R5 by FHIR-I. It asked the Search page prefix comparison table to clarify which side of each comparison is the resource value and which is the query parameter value, replacing confusing terms such as "value for the parameter in the resource", "provided value", "search value", and "target value".
initial_application: The issue appears to have been applied by untrailed source commit c2797dba0249dc9e72b28a0c539ceb1f576cf55e, "FHIR-40029 - Clarification on prefix comparison value names." That commit edited source/search.html to define "parameter value" and "resource value" and to replace the old ambiguous terms throughout the prefix table. The commit is an ancestor of the current worker branch, and no Issue-Reconcile-Key commit for FHIR-40029 was present on the combined branch before this audit.
additional_context: source/search.html is an active current FHIR-core page, listed in publish.ini. Later applied issue FHIR-40319 used the FHIR-40029 terminology as a basis for further boundary-interpretation and example work in the same prefix table; FHIR-40319 already has its own Issue-Reconcile-Key commit on the combined branch, so this result does not duplicate it. FHIR-I minutes for the January 2023 WGM record the FHIR-40029 Persuasive 11-0-5 vote, and community searches found no later conflicting decision.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. The current active Search page already defines "parameter value" and "resource value", uses those terms in the prefix comparison table, and no longer contains the exact old ambiguous table wording targeted by FHIR-40029.

related_jiras.note: Applied R6 issue that builds on the FHIR-40029 terminology to add clearer boundary interpretations and examples for the same Search prefix table; it is already represented on the combined branch by Issue-Reconcile-Key commit a98cd648b3058f2e2541049bbd0f1e2fa0b8b541.
